html:
The Wuli Wuli were an Aboriginal Australian people of inland southeast Queensland, on the map in the upper Burnett River country.

Almost nothing is recorded about them. Their neighbours on the map are the Yiman to the west, the Wadjigu and Gangulu to the north, and the Gooreng Gooreng toward the coast. Squatters took up the Burnett in the late 1840s.
sum: The Wuli Wuli were an Aboriginal Australian people of inland southeast Queensland, on the map in the upper Burnett River country.
